home-manager.reason: The niri module commit removes the `extraConfigEarly` option entirely; if any host's home configuration references it, evaluation will fail with an undefined-option error.

recommendation.recommendation: Update any host configuration that references `wayland.windowManager.niri.extraConfigEarly` to use `lib.mkBefore` (or `lib.mkOrder`) applied to `extraConfig` instead, then unhold the `home-manager` input, since the removal PR was approved by maintainers and merged.
recommendation.basis: Maintainer glmlm (MEMBER) opened PR #9914 to remove `extraConfigEarly` in favour of `mkOrder` on `extraConfig`; maintainer teto (COLLABORATOR) gave two APPROVED reviews, and maintainer khaneliman (COLLABORATOR) endorsed the `mkOrder` approach in linked issue #9738, stating that separate ordering options are "unnecessarily complex" when Nix eval handles ordering natively. The PR was merged 2026-09-18 and issue #9738 was closed as completed. The migration pattern endorsed by khaneliman is `extraConfig = lib.mkMerge [ (lib.mkBefore ''…'') ''…'' ];`, which preserves the before/after ordering that `extraConfigEarly` previously provided.
